description: The government is also setting up an independent Department of Electronics, Information Technology and Artificial Intelligence for effective policymaking.
body_lead: Maharahstra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis on March 6 announced that the government has signed letters of intent with prominent global and national level artificial intelligence (AI) companies to boost the state’s information technology sector. These memorandum of understanding (MoUs) have been signed with OpenAI, Sarvam AI, IIT Bombay and BharatGen, Fandavis said. He was presenting the State Budget 2026-2027 in Mumbai.
